$ edit b/corpus_test.go  # a package b over the corpus
$ edit testdata/script/twice.txtar  # give the variants shout/ trees
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # variants
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
